card.name: "Without" before warning symptoms
card.fires_on: The word "without" in the NSAID boxed warning phrase "at any time during use and without warning symptoms", where "symptoms" comes next.

modes.label: Without warning symptoms
modes.description: The word "without" sits right before "warning symptoms" in the stomach and intestinal bleeding warning.
modes.example: These events can occur at any time during use and<< without>> warning symptoms. Elderly patients and patients

card.plain: It fires on "without" when the next word is expected to be "symptoms", as in bleeding that can happen without warning symptoms.
